summary: Enhance your skills in humanitarian coordination and partnerships with our comprehensive training course. Join us to make a meaningful impact in the field.
lede: Humanitarian coordination helps response professionals align partners, assess coverage and connect operational evidence with response planning. Participants practise applying the IASC cluster approach, maintaining 3W or 5W reporting, analysing gaps and facilitating partner decisions. They also develop meeting systems, referral pathways and accountability tracking informed by the Sphere Handbook and Core Humanitarian Standard.
audienceIntro: Humanitarian coordination professionals often move between field-level problem solving, inter-agency planning, partner diplomacy, and executive reporting. This course suits professionals who need a practical foundation and a stronger operational method for aligning humanitarian action.
prerequisites: This foundation to intermediate course requires practical exposure to humanitarian programmes, emergency response, partnership work, community engagement, or inter-agency operations. You should be able to read basic programme data and contribute to operational meetings. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with humanitarian principles is useful but not essential. Advanced digital analysis, AI-assisted information review, and dashboard configuration are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
